rationale: The only code delta is that the fixed implementation moves the read of dp->ip6r_len until after ND_TCHECK(dp->ip6r_segleft), whereas the vulnerable implementation reads that field before the availability check. The Logic section states generally that the function checks available data, prints header fields, processes supported routing types and addresses, and reports truncation. Those behavioral claims are shared by both implementations and do not specifically state that validation occurs before reading the length field or otherwise describe the added ordering safeguard.
